Chapter 184: Chapter 19 Return (Please Subscribe)_2

However, in order to continue enjoying the vast Heavenly Earth Vital Energy brought by the inhalation and exhalation of the Eye of the North Sea, Lin Yuan had forcibly dragged on until now.

It seemed that the World Consciousness of this realm had noticed.

But it had no way to intervene.

The World Consciousness still relied on Lin Yuan to deal with the Eye of the North Sea, so it was impossible to fall out with him at this time.

Only now.

Lin Yuan had already reached the twelfth segment of the Fifth Rank, and his subsequent cultivation had little to do with the external Primordial Qi.

...

Moreover, with only a little more than ten years remaining until his stay limit, there was no need to continue lingering here.

“Suppress.”

With this thought, Lin Yuan looked down at the hundred-meter radius of the Eye of the North Sea below.

Boom-boom-boom.

Under the terrifying suppression, once again, it cascaded downward.

The hundred-meter-wide Eye of the North Sea immediately began to shrink again.

Ninety meters.

Eighty meters.

Seventy meters.

…..

Just as the Eye of the North Sea had shrunk to ten meters.

A terrifying consciousness pierced through the Eye of the North Sea, reaching Lin Yuan’s ear.

“Cease your actions.”

This terrifying consciousness emitted psychic fluctuations that allowed Lin Yuan to intuitively understand the meaning it conveyed.

“Cease your actions?”

Lin Yuan let out a slight smile, unconcerned.

Over the years, he had long surmised that behind the Eye of the North Sea stood a powerful being.

Because when he observed the Eye of the North Sea carefully, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he would occasionally enlighten himself to some ‘devouring’ secret techniques.

Of course, these devouring secret techniques were not comparable to the ‘Devouring Heaven’ Evolution Path, but it was obvious that they belonged to the unique skills of some powerful existences.

Lin Yuan originally thought that the existence behind the Eye of the North Sea would remain silent until it was completely suppressed.

Only he did not expect that the other party would ultimately lose patience.

“As long as you cease your actions,”

“Everything is negotiable.”

The terrifying consciousness sounded somewhat urgent.

“We can make a deal.”

The terrifying consciousness continued to emit psychic fluctuations.

“I’m not interested in deals.”

Lin Yuan did not cease his suppression, and the Eye of the North Sea continued to shrink.

To be precise, Lin Yuan had little interest in making deals where there was too great a disparity between the parties.

The existence behind the Eye of the North Sea was at least a powerhouse beyond the Sixth Rank, and making deals with such a being was akin to negotiating with a tiger for its skin.

Who knew when he might fall into the other party’s hands?

Lin Yuan was willing to make deals with the World Consciousness because the World Consciousness was not a sentient being, without emotions like joy, anger, sorrow, or personal feelings.

Moreover, Lin Yuan had means to contend with the World Consciousness if necessary; in the worst-case scenario, he could just destroy this world, and nobody would benefit.

But the existence behind the Eye of the North Sea? Lin Yuan didn’t think he had any means to restrain it.

Instead of worrying about fear, it was better to avoid contact altogether.

Boom-boom-boom.

The Eye of the North Sea continued to shrink.

Five meters.

Three meters.

One meter.

At last.

The terrifying consciousness that originated from the depths of the Eye of the North Sea began to curse.

Hum.

An invisible psychic attack swiftly penetrated Lin Yuan’s Primordial Spirit.

Unfortunately.

Lin Yuan’s Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit had united as one, forming the Taiji Primordial Spirit, immensely stable, augmented by the psychic defense secret technique ‘Mind Palace Tower.’

Faced with a psychic attack that originated from the depths of the Eye of the North Sea, its power unknowably weakened by many times, he naturally had nothing to fear.

Ultimately.

Several days later.

The Eye of the North Sea shrank to a speck finer than a strand of hair.

With a slight motion of Lin Yuan’s mind, the speck fell into his hand.

With such a size, the Eye of the North Sea no longer posed any threat.

It couldn’t even perform the inhalation and exhalation of Heavenly Earth Vital Energy anymore.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished.

He appeared above North Sea Island.

By this time, Master Nalan, along with the five Deputy Island Masters and many Tenth Realm individuals, had long been waiting in their place.

When the Eye of the North Sea continued to shrink down to ten meters, Master Nalan and the others realized that the greatest threat looming over countless powerhouses in this world might become a thing of the past.

Therefore, they had led everyone to wait here early on.

After all, once the Eye of the North Sea was fully dealt with, the mysterious powerful individual would naturally appear.

“You have lived here for thousands, tens of thousands of years…”

Lin Yuan looked towards Master Nalan and the other powerhouses.

The thousands, tens of thousands of years here referred not to a single generation but to generations upon generations.

Since hundreds of thousands of years ago, when the Eye of the North Sea first appeared, under the implications of the World Consciousness, one powerful being after another arrived here.

After hundreds of thousands of years of proliferation, even Master Nalan was a descendant of some of the early generations of powerhouses.

“However, everyone will need to continue staying for another five hundred years before you can go to the Five Domains,” Lin Yuan said indifferently, surveying his surroundings.

Currently, the Demonic Tao forces that Lin Yuan had left on the Five Domains Mainland were enough to suppress everything.

But if the powerhouses from North Sea Island were to swarm into the Five Domains, it would be a different story.

Dozens of Tenth Realm powerhouses and six Eleventh Realm powerhouses could completely disrupt the situation in the Five Domains.

Therefore, Lin Yuan set a five-hundred-year period for everyone.

With this buffer time, losing the inhalation and exhalation of the Eye of the North Sea, the Five Domains’ Heavenly Earth Vital Energy will recover, and it’s possible for some Tenth or even Eleventh Realm powerhouses to emerge after five hundred years.

“Yes,” Master Nalan and the other powerhouses agreed without hesitation.

They had managed to wait for thousands, tens of thousands of years; naturally, a mere five hundred years was not a problem.

“In that case…”

With a wave of his hand, Lin Yuan sent out specks of light that flew into the foreheads of each powerful being.

These specks of light were formulated by Lin Yuan using the aura of the North Sea Island combined with his own power.

If anyone left the boundaries of the North Sea Island region, it would trigger the light to self-destruct.

“Remember, you can go to the Five Domains only after five hundred years,” Lin Yuan reminded them once more before his figure disappeared from view.

…..

Five Domains.
